description: This file contains utility functions for resolving npm package specifications, building installation records, and managing pinned npm versions within a package management context. It interacts with external utilities for resolution metadata and provides logging notifications.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmSpec(params: { resolvePinnedNpmSpec
methods.description: Determines the record specification for an npm package, optionally pinning to a precise version and providing warnings if resolution isn't possible.

methods.name: export function mapNpmResolutionMetadata(resolution?: NpmResolutionMetadata): { mapNpmResolutionMetadata
methods.description: Converts npm resolution metadata into a simplified, structured object.

methods.name: export function buildNpmInstallRecordFields(params: { buildNpmInstallRecordFields
methods.description: Constructs an npm install record with detailed resolution and specification info for installation purposes.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecord(params: { resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecord
methods.description: Creates a detailed npm install record while resolving pinning and logging relevant messages.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecordForCli( resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecordForCli
methods.description: A CLI-specific wrapper around resolving an npm install record, incorporating logging and warning message formatting.

methods.name: export function logPinnedNpmSpecMessages( logPinnedNpmSpecMessages
methods.description: Logs warning and notice messages related to npm pinning status to the console.
